title: 第三章 伊莱娜第四章 牵线人
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工

睁开眼，太刺眼了还是闭上吧。
醒来的林奇只感觉腰酸背痛，昨天跟两个杀手干了一架还没缓过来就直接被系统灌输的记忆强制关机，直接在外面躺了一晚上。
林奇摸了把脸，是汗？面对那种对手我会出汗？
啊呸，是眼泪？我居然会因为看别人的记忆产生共情而流泪了？
代价：放大内心的情感。
狠狠地拍了自己两下，让自己强制开机的林奇走进了屋内。
他先把所有的门窗关紧然后看着客厅的两具尸体陷入了沉思。
这俩尸体在客厅放了一个晚上，血迹都已经干涸了，现在应该怎么办呢？
经常杀人的朋友都知道，干涸的血迹最难擦了，啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
就在林奇想着应该怎么处理这两具尸体时突然传来了门铃声。
坏了！
“谁啊？”林奇迅速用身体堵住大门，朝着门外的人问。
“伊萨里斯？是我啊，舅舅来看你了。”门外传来了一个温润的男声。
是在伊萨里斯记忆中见过的人。
不行，不能让他进来。
客厅里的尸体还没有处理。
“嘎吱——”
门开了。
代价：做出不理智的行为。

“舅舅......”林奇有些尴尬，怎么脑子里想的是一回事手上做的又是一回事。
“现在怎么办？要不干脆把他也弄了？”阴暗的想法充满了林奇的内心。
“伊萨里斯，这是怎么回事？”奥尔丁·罗兰指着客厅的两具尸体惊讶的问。
“呃...我也不知道，他们是晚上偷偷进来的，我发现之后用父亲留下的枪把他们打死了。”林奇如实回答。
“嗯...居然是入室抢劫吗？这里的治安也不太行啊，别担心伊萨里斯，交给舅舅处理吧。
你今天收拾收拾东西跟舅舅回罗兰庄园住吧。”奥尔丁摸了摸林奇的头安慰道。
“？？？看见尸体不害怕？等等，这又不是上一世那个和平世界，这可是终末纪元，一个充满超能力者的地方。”
想明白的林奇悄悄松了一口气。
根据伊萨里斯的记忆他这个舅舅从小对他就很好，应该可以相信吧？
这么想着的林奇就看见奥尔丁从裤兜中拿出了一个东西。
电话？？？
不是，哥们家还用油灯呢你这电话哪来的？
似乎是看见了林奇的惊讶，奥尔丁轻笑了一声说道：“这是墨尔家族最近的产业，叫通讯机。
现在能通过这个东西直接联系到警局。喜欢吗？墨尔家族送了舅舅很多个，今天跟舅舅回庄园舅舅给你也拿一个。”
“呃...舅舅，我还是不去了。庄园里的大家都不喜欢我，我自己住在这里挺好的。”
林奇低着脑袋，用硬挤出来的可怜语气说道。
“唉...”听到这话的奥尔丁没有多说什么只是拍了拍林奇的肩膀，“那舅舅今天陪你在这里住，你不会不欢迎舅舅吧？”
林奇有些难办。
他在这住林奇还怎么完成浪漫序列的晋升仪式？
虽然是亲舅舅，但是那是伊萨里斯的舅舅又不是我林某人的舅舅。

“哈哈，舅舅开玩笑的，你没事就好，自己一定要注意安全，一会儿会有人来处理尸体，舅舅就先走了。”

Open your eyes, it's too dazzling so close them.
When Lynch woke up, he only felt pain in his waist and back. Before he could recover from the fight with two killers yesterday, he was forced to shut down by the memory instilled by the system, and he lay outside all night.
Lin Qi touched his face. Was it sweat? Would I sweat against that kind of opponent?
Ah, are they tears? I actually cried because I felt empathy when looking at other people’s memories?
The price: amplifying inner emotions.
Lin Qi, who slapped himself hard twice and forced himself to turn on his phone, walked into the house.
He first closed all the doors and windows tightly and then looked at the two corpses in the living room and fell into deep thought.
These two bodies have been left in the living room all night, and the blood has dried. What should we do now?
Friends who often kill people know that dried blood is the hardest to wipe off. Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhinging
Just when Lynch was thinking about what to do with the two bodies, the doorbell suddenly sounded.
broken!
"Who is it?" Lin Qi quickly blocked the door with his body and asked the person outside.
"Isaris? It's me. Uncle is here to see you." A gentle male voice came from outside the door.
It was someone Isaris had seen in his memory.
No, we can't let him in.
The body in the living room has not yet been disposed of.
"Crunch——"
The door opened.
The price: irrational behavior.
"Uncle..." Lin Qi was a little embarrassed. Why was he thinking about one thing and doing something else with his hands.
"What should we do now? How about getting him too?" Dark thoughts filled Lynch's heart.
"Isaris, what's going on?" Aldin Roland pointed at the two corpses in the living room and asked in surprise.
"Uh... I don't know. They sneaked in at night. I found out and shot them to death with the gun my father left behind." Lynch answered truthfully.
"Hmm... Is it actually a burglary? The security here is not very good. Don't worry about Isaris, let your uncle handle it.
You pack your things today and go back to Roland Manor to stay with your uncle. "Aldin touched Lynch's head and comforted him.
"???Aren't you afraid when you see corpses? Wait, this is not the peaceful world in the last life. This is the end of the world, a place full of superpowers."
Lin Qi, who figured it out, breathed a sigh of relief.
According to Isalis's memory, his uncle has been very good to him since he was a child, so he should be able to believe it, right?
With Lynch thinking this way, he saw Alding take something out of his trouser pocket.
Telephone? ? ?
No, my friend’s house still uses oil lamps. Where did you get this phone number?
Seemingly seeing Lynch's surprise, Aldin chuckled and said, "This is the Moore family's latest property, called a communication machine.
Now you can contact the police directly through this thing. Like it? The Moore family gave uncle a lot of them. I will go back to the manor with my uncle today and he will get one for you too. "
"Uh...Uncle, I'd better not go. Everyone in the manor doesn't like me. It's fine for me to live here by myself."
Lynch lowered his head and said in a pitiful tone.
"Alas..." After hearing this, Aldin didn't say anything and just patted Lynch on the shoulder, "Then uncle will stay here with you today. You won't welcome uncle, right?"
Lynch was having a hard time.
How can he complete the promotion ceremony of the romantic sequence when he lives in Lynch?
Although he is a biological uncle, he is Isaris's uncle and not Lin's uncle.
"Haha, uncle is joking. As long as you are fine, you must pay attention to your own safety. Someone will come to dispose of the body in a while, so uncle will leave first."
